question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        im.month_year,
        im.interest_id,
        im._year,
        im._month,
        AVG(im.composition / im.index_value) as avg_comp_idx
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE (im._year = 2018 AND im._month >= 9) 
       OR (im._year = 2019 AND im._month <= 8)
    GROUP BY im.month_year, im.interest_id, im._year, im._month
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ma.month_year,
        ma.interest_id,
        ma.avg_comp_idx,
        ma._year,
        ma._month,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ma.month_year ORDER BY ma.avg_comp_idx DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg ma
),
monthly_top AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r.interest_id, r.avg_comp_idx as max_comp_idx, r._year, r._month
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
with_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        mt.month_year,
        im.interest_name,
        mt.max_comp_idx,
        AVG(mt.max_comp_idx) OVER (ORDER BY mt._year, mt._month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_3m,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY mt._year, mt._month) as prev_month_interest,
        LAG(mt.max_comp_idx, 1) OVER (ORDER BY mt._year, mt._month) as prev_month_max,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY mt._year, mt._month) as two_months_ago_interest,
        LAG(mt.max_comp_idx, 2) OVER (ORDER BY mt._year, mt._month) as two_months_ago_max
    FROM monthly_top mt
    JOIN interest_map im ON mt.interest_id = im.id
)
SELECT month_year, interest_name, max_comp_idx, rolling_avg_3m, 
       prev_month_interest, prev_month_max, 
       two_months_ago_interest, two_months_ago_max
FROM with_lags 
ORDER BY month_year
